what: Mistake: Sri had to ask about code quality before anyone noticed it. gh.rs had grown to 5,276 lines and run.rs's produce_and_verify to 724 lines, both changed in about 10 landings in a week and the site of this week's breakages, and Sri's request of 2026-10-17 to reconsider the design every few jobs (20261017-205558-dn2e) sat unrun because the brain kept ranking other work above it.
why: Code health needs a standing check with thresholds that queues work itself (Hestia's scope), and the periodic design review must run on its own cadence rather than wait to be ranked.
